author: Lakhman
body:
Hello Avic.us staff again,
                     
                                 I just got banned for ban evading?

                                    I dont know what that is but it also includes an minecraft ign off "TROLLDUDE". I do not even know who "TROLLDUDE" even is. I have no clue why this "FrostedCupcakes" Mod banned me.

                              This is the second time i got banned from this mod.

                         Avic.us i have done nothing wrong this time..... yet you still ban me.
                         
                           Please unban me.

            I am giving up on this server. Two false bans in 5 minutes.
